properties.name: jwt.access-token-expire-time
properties.description: 访问令牌有效期(分钟)

properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: jwt密钥

properties.name: jwt.refresh-token-expire-time
properties.description: 刷新令牌有效期(分钟)

properties.name: jwt.header
properties.description: Token Header

properties.name: logging.frontend.max-per-user
properties.description: 每个用户允许存储在数据库中的最大前端日志条数

properties.name: logging.sse.life
properties.description: SSE 连接的会话超时时间（SseEmitter 超时时间）

properties.name: logging.sse.heartbeat.base
properties.description: SSE 心跳的基础间隔（动态调度下限）

properties.name: logging.sse.heartbeat.multiplier
properties.description: SSE 心跳倍率 P，用于 computedDelay = max(base, lastCost * P)

properties.name: logging.sse.heartbeat.max
properties.description: SSE 心跳最大间隔上限，避免客户端/代理误判掉线

properties.name: logging.sse.broadcast.jitter.enabled
properties.description: 是否在广播发送时为不同用户添加随机抖动，平滑客户端并发拉取

properties.name: logging.sse.broadcast.jitter.max
properties.description: 广播抖动的最大延迟时间（Duration）

properties.name: logging.sse.broadcast.batch.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用按批次分发广播事件（批间隔 + 批内抖动）

properties.name: logging.sse.broadcast.batch.size
properties.description: 广播每批推送的连接数量

properties.name: logging.sse.broadcast.batch.gap
properties.description: 广播批与批之间的间隔

properties.name: logging.sse.broadcast.batch.within-jitter
properties.description: 广播批内的轻微抖动上限

properties.name: file.upload.max-file-size
properties.description: 文件上传大小限制（字节），默认 20MB

properties.name: file.upload.presigned-url-expiry-minutes
properties.description: 预签名URL有效期（分钟），默认 5 分钟

properties.name: file.upload.max-attachments-per-reservation
properties.description: 单个预约最大附件数量，默认 10 个

properties.name: file.upload.allowed-extensions
properties.description: 允许上传的文件扩展名列表（包含点号，如 .jpg）

properties.name: minio.endpoint
properties.description: MinIO 服务端点地址，例如: http://localhost:9000

properties.name: minio.access-key
properties.description: MinIO 访问密钥（Access Key）

properties.name: minio.secret-key
properties.description: MinIO 密钥（Secret Key）

properties.name: minio.bucket-name
properties.description: MinIO 默认存储桶名称
